title: Falcons list James Pearce, Divine Diablo as questionable for Sunday

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Falcons list James Pearce, Divine Diablo as questionable for Sunday
sources.description: Falcons defensive coordinator Jeff Ulbrich said this week that the Falcons plan to use linebacker James Pearce in a pass rushing role against the Bengals in Madrid this Sunday, but the team didn't guarantee he'll be playing on their final injury report of the week.
